Maya: Quiet update — overnight traffic spiked after the soft EU rollout, we saw ~520k DAU and 3.2M inference requests between 02:00-06:00 UTC. low error rate, latencies held under the SLOs. :tada:
Sam: omg congrats team :rocket: croissants on me in the kitchen at 10?
Jordan: I’ll bring the good coffee. also remote folks — zoom toast? :coffee:
Devon: massive kudos to infra and routing—autoscaler behaved exactly like we hoped. @Lee you crushed the rollout rules. :muscle:
Lee: thanks! shoutout to @Maya for the canary checks and @Devon for the quick rollback playbook test. :confetti_ball:
ops-bot: deploybot: PROD deploy v1.9.3 -> success (green) — no incidents logged in the window.
Maya: love that. tiny celebratory poll: cake or croissants? react with :cake: or :croissant: (also stickers? yes/no)
Sam: :croissant: +1, stickers please :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Jordan: stickers yes. and maybe a little gong for the rooftop toast?
Devon: can we do a quick 5-min retro tomorrow to capture what worked for the EU seed traffic? otherwise quick cheers now :party_parrot:
Lee: retro tomorrow sounds good. for now — 10:05 kitchen meetup, 10:15 Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.example/soft-launch-toast
Maya: adding a tiny shoutout list — @Lee @Devon @Jordan @Sam for the ops overnight. couldn’t have done it without you. :heart:
Sam: virtual high-fives for everyone else who pushed fixes last night :raised_hands:
Jordan: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-teamwork-xyz :sparkles:
Maya: ok team — quick celebration, tiny sugar crash, back to ship more wins. :cake: :rocket:
